mapper.select: SELECT subject_id, login_name, password_hash, status, version, created_at FROM organization_access.subject_identity WHERE subject_id = #{subjectId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM organization_access.platform_role_binding WHERE subject_id = #{subjectId} AND role_code = 'PLATFORM_ACCOUNT_ADMINISTRATOR' AND status = 'ACTIVE')

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM organization_access.platform_role_binding binding INNER JOIN organization_access.subject_identity subject ON subject.subject_id = binding.subject_id WHERE binding.role_code = 'PLATFORM_ACCOUNT_ADMINISTRATOR' AND binding.status = 'ACTIVE' AND subject.status = 'ACTIVE' AND binding.subject_id <> #{subjectId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO organization_access.subject_identity (subject_id, login_name, password_hash, status, version, created_at) VALUES (#{subjectId}, #{loginName}, #{passwordHash}, #{status}, #{version}, #{createdAt}) ON CONFLICT (login_name) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE organization_access.subject_identity SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, status = #{status}, version = #{version} WHERE subject_id = #{subjectId} AND version = #{expectedVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT subject.subject_id, subject.login_name, subject.status, subject.version, subject.created_at, COALESCE(string_agg(binding.role_code, ',' ORDER BY binding.role_code), '') AS active_role_codes FROM organization_access.subject_identity subject LEFT JOIN organization_access.platform_role_binding binding ON binding.subject_id = subject.subject_id AND binding.status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY subject.subject_id, subject.login_name, subject.status, subject.version, subject.created_at ORDER BY subject.created_at DESC, subject.subject_id DESC OFFSET #{offset} LIMIT #{limit}
